cells.gaps: No source found says a law, decree, regulation or circular requires public bodies to use the standards.
cells.note: The 2020 framework names the technical standards government systems are to use (BEN-001), and ASIN treated it as in place in July 2026 (BEN-003); the 2026 architecture-policy draft (BEN-004) is a further text and lowers nothing. Stage 4 needs an instrument making the standards compulsory: the framework's own wording does not count and the decree's text is not held.
